senses.gloss: f. (לָוָה) escort, company, esp. the traveller’s escort for protection.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Sotah 9:6">Sot. IX, 6</cite> <he>והנחנוהו בלא ל׳</he> and we let him (the stranger) go without protection; (Y. ib. IX, 23ᵈ bot. <cite ref="E00540"><he>הלוייה</he></cite>). Bab. ib. 46ᵇ <he>כופין לל׳</he> we may force (the inhabitans of a place) to provide escorts for travellers. Ib. <he>המהלך … ואין לו ל׳ וכ׳</he> he who travels on the road and has no company, let him be engaged in study of the Law (ref. to <he>לִוְיַת</he>, <cite ref="Proverbs 1:9">Prov. I, 9</cite>); <cite ref="Eruvin 54a:6">Erub. 54ᵃ</cite>.
<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 104:2">Midr. Till. to Ps. CIV, 1</cite> <he>יהא אליך לְוָיָיתְךָ</he> (or <he>לִוְיָיתְךָ</he>) thy God be thy escort; a. e.
